newsitem.title: UK: Mediakey up as Fidelity increases stake.
newsitem.headline: Mediakey up as Fidelity increases stake.

text.p: Shares in multimedia publishing and training group Mediakey Plc, which owns the Video Arts group set up by comedian John Cleese, rose in active trade on Monday after it said U.S. fund manager Fidelity had raised its stake.

Mediakey also said that David Gordon, a non-executive director, had bought 15,000 shares at a price of 32p per share. The stock was up 3p at 35 in volume of 797,600 shares, having languished below 30p for much of the past month -- well below the high of 71p it reached last June following its flotation in January 1996.

Mediakey said Fidelity, one of the biggest and closely- watched fund managers in the U.S., had raised its stake to 3.8 million shares or seven percent of the total, though its previous holding was not disclosed.
